pkgmetadata.longdescription: Keeps the Wi-Fi and Bluetooth firmware on the installed macOS, as macOS does: a systemd service reads the firmware from the macOS system volume (APFS, read-only) and stages it so it is applied at the next boot. Port of alarm-aurora aurora-wifi-firmware 0.2, pinned to the shared sources.json aurora-installer commit.

use.flag: Handle LZFSE-compressed files on the macOS system volume via app-arch/lzfse
